requested_action: Owner to resolve canonical project-relative placement and provide analyst access to one maintained dataset plus matching quality manifests. These targets are proposed expectations pending owner evidence, not proof of placement or authorization for this analyst to move data.
requirements: Retain raw data outside Git tracking.
Provide source hash, schema, adjustment basis, timestamp/session semantics, freshness, coverage and explicit gaps.
Use the existing data-owner branch and code/tests; this consumer branch is for NVDA analysis only.
Confirm destination acceptance and actual readback before marking available.
analysis_need: October 1 onward cumulative share volume and turnover, with regular/extended-session boundaries and complete-period qualification.

fetch_routing.qc_policy: Reuse owner automated risk-based QC; reassess changed revisions and new failures. Consumer routing metadata is not runtime enforcement or evidence of request delivery.

temporal_policy.historical_interval: Require explicit coverage, revisions, units and adjustment; report gaps without extrapolation.
temporal_policy.current_session: Require separately timestamped observations with measured lag and partial-session labeling.

provenance_policy: Distinguish user-asserted source, artifact labels, independent provider evidence and unknown adjustment/vintages. Decimal volume alone is not invalid. Private delivery receipts remain local.
publication_status_note: Public structural snapshot only; existing state fields are historical snapshot values, not the active local delivery ledger.
